mike: opening the maintenance window for tenant_id -> tenant_uuid change. deploybot will run a controlled partial apply canary at 21:10 UTC. plan: apply DDL, run small backfill (0.5% shard), validate, then widen.
anya: copying checklist: pin app image for canary, preflight DB checks, and monitoring hooks. which app image are we pinning?
jordan: pin canary to release/2.14.1 and set fallback to release/2.14.0. i'll update the deploybot job.
deploy-bot: queued job deploy-1726678888-partial-apply-canary (image=release/2.14.1) scheduled for 2024-05-06T21:10:00Z. preflight hooks: schema-verify, lock-scan, sample-backfill-run.
mike: in staging preflight we saw a postgres advisory lock from a background job during the backfill. we need an ops escape sequence in prod.
ops-runner: ops checklist snippet:

1) run lock scan:
   SELECT pid, usename, wait_event_type, wait_event, query
   FROM pg_stat_activity
   WHERE wait_event_type='Lock' OR state='idle in transaction';
2) identify long-running transactions: check age with now() - xact_start
3) if a single pid blocks > 60s, try pg_cancel_backend(pid) then escalate; pg_terminate_backend only after approval.

add to runbook: if >2 blocking pids or >1 minute of queued backfill rows, fail preflight.
anya: can we make deploybot auto-fail on those conditions? last canary stalled for 8 minutes.
jordan: yes — adding a preflight gate: fail if blocking_pids_count > 1 OR queued_backfill_rows > 0 after 60s. fallback policy = automatic rollback to release/2.14.0 and mark canary failed.
mike: backfill strategy: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%, validate row counts and checksum after each stage. each stage max 90 minutes, abort on contention.
ops-runner: if contention at 5% then DDL stays applied but pause data migration and open ticket for async backfill with lower batch size. include diagnostic dump: pg_locks, pg_stat_activity snapshot.
deploy-bot: runbook note added: "on detected lock during preflight: pause canary, post details in #eng-releases, run blocking query, wait 3m, escalate to db-oncall if unresolved" :alarm_clock:
anya: release notes snippet for docs: "Schema change: tenant_uuid introduced, tenant_id retained during phased migration. Controlled background backfills will migrate UUIDs. Pin client versions during canary window. See runbook for rollback and escalation steps." 
jordan: i'll be watching the slot and oncall for DB will be on standby. if rollback happens, capture diagnostics: pg_stat_activity, pg_locks, last backfill progress, deploybot logs.
mike: starting preflight in ~10m. i'll post a short message when it begins so infra and monitoring teams can tune dashboards.
anya: thanks — tagging monitoring and platform: @jordan @ops-runner :eyes:
mike: preflight start posted. last_message_ts=1726679150
